kind: human-readable testable policy model, not an executable fare engine
disclaimer: Independent source-backed paraphrases for research. Not official BKK advice. Recheck time-sensitive information before real travel.

rules.summary: Street-level single ticket covers one uninterrupted one-way ride.
when: Passenger uses an ordinary single ticket on a street-level service in Budapest.
rules.expected: Do not recommend using the same ordinary single ticket for a voluntary transfer to a different street-level vehicle.
exceptions: Metro-to-metro transfers in one direction are permitted (R002).
Unplanned replacement vehicle situations have specific revalidation rules and are outside this general case.
ask_if_missing: Is your trip on the metro only, or do you need another bus/tram?

rules.summary: Single ticket allows metro-line transfers during one continuous journey.
when: Passenger transfers between M1/M2/M3/M4 without reversing direction.
Ticket is valid and has been validated.
rules.expected: A new ordinary single ticket is not required solely for the metro-line transfer.
exceptions: No return trip or direction reversal on the same ticket.
ask_if_missing: Will you leave the metro network or return in the opposite direction?

rules.summary: Single-ticket uninterrupted ride has time limits.
when: Ticket is used for an ordinary uninterrupted single ride.
rules.expected: Apply an 80-minute limit on normal services, and a 120-minute limit on night services; unused minutes cannot be carried forward.
exceptions: For disruption/replacement service, consult separate official rules.
ask_if_missing: Are you travelling on a night service?

rules.summary: 30-minute ticket allows transfers within 30 minutes after first validation.
when: Valid 30-minute mobile ticket.
Last transfer occurs no later than 30 minutes after first validation.
Travel remains within the ticket's covered service area.
rules.expected: Passenger may finish the final ride even after 30 minutes, remaining on that vehicle until alighting.
exceptions: Do not start another transfer after the 30-minute transfer window.
ask_if_missing: When did you first validate? At what minute is your last transfer?

rules.summary: 30-minute ticket requires validation and revalidation at non-metro transfers.
when: Passenger uses a 30-minute digital ticket.
rules.expected: Validate at start and at each boarding/transfer to another line; no repeat validation is required solely between metro lines.
exceptions: Do not tell users that one first scan covers all surface-line transfers.
ask_if_missing: Does your connection involve two metro lines, or a tram/bus?

rules.summary: 30-minute ticket is mobile-only and requires internet.
when: Passenger asks for a paper 30-minute ticket or attempts offline mobile use.
rules.expected: Explain that there is no paper equivalent and active internet is needed for the mobile ticket.
exceptions: A conventional paper single ticket is a different product with different transfer rules.
ask_if_missing: Do you have a phone with internet access for your trip?

rules.summary: 90-minute ticket transfer window and continued final ride.
when: Valid 90-minute mobile ticket.
Last transfer starts no later than 90 minutes after first validation.
Trip is within the covered area.
rules.expected: Allow unlimited transfers within the 90-minute window and completion of the already-started final ride after the window.
exceptions: A transfer started after the window is not covered.
Return travel is possible within the ticket's validity, subject to the same window.
ask_if_missing: How long after first validation is your last transfer?

rules.summary: Ordinary single tickets and standard passes are not sufficient on 100E.
when: Passenger proposes boarding 100E with only an ordinary BKK single ticket or a regular pass.
rules.expected: Do not confirm 100E eligibility on that product alone; assess full airport ticket, permitted add-on, or documented free-travel entitlement.
exceptions: A valid eligible pass plus the airport add-on is a separate valid combination.
Documented free travel categories exist.
ask_if_missing: Are you using the 100E or the 200E? Which pass do you have?

rules.summary: Full-fare 100E airport ticket is for one uninterrupted one-way trip.
when: Passenger uses bus 100E.
No eligible add-on pass or documented free-travel right has been established.
rules.expected: Offer the published 100E full-price ticket from the fare snapshot (2,500 HUF), noting that the ticket does not allow transfers to other lines.
exceptions: The 1,000 HUF add-on applies only under its eligibility rules.
Current official prices take priority over this snapshot.
ask_if_missing: Do you hold any eligible Budapest, county or national pass? Are any free-travel conditions relevant?

rules.summary: 100E add-on eligibility requires a valid eligible pass, excluding 15-day and job-seeker passes.
when: Passenger wants to travel on 100E using an airport add-on.
They hold a valid Budapest-pass other than a 15-day pass or monthly job-seeker pass, or a valid Pest County Pass or Hungary Pass.
rules.expected: Offer the 1,000 HUF add-on alongside the eligible valid pass.
exceptions: 15-day Budapest-pass is explicitly excluded.
Monthly pass for job seekers is not combinable.
For uncertain pass names, ask before concluding.
ask_if_missing: What exact pass type do you hold, and is it currently valid?

rules.summary: 100E add-on is purchased in BudapestGO and covers one 100E journey.
when: Passenger is eligible for an airport add-on.
rules.expected: Explain that the add-on is available only via BudapestGO and covers one uninterrupted 100E journey, not other lines.
exceptions: Do not claim the agent can purchase the ticket.
ask_if_missing: Do you have the BudapestGO app?

rules.summary: 100E free travel for qualifying under-14 students.
when: Passenger is under age 14.
They present a Hungarian student ID card.
rules.expected: Identify the documented free-travel entitlement on 100E, subject to current official eligibility details.
exceptions: Do not infer the discount from a foreign student ID alone.
ask_if_missing: How old is the traveller? Do they have a Hungarian student ID?

rules.summary: 100E free travel for travellers over 65 with proof of age.
when: Traveller is over 65 and can show proof of age.
rules.expected: Identify the free-travel entitlement on 100E.
exceptions: Source wording is 'over 65'; avoid adjudicating an exact-65th-birthday boundary without checking the detailed eligibility page.
ask_if_missing: Can you confirm the traveller's age and available proof?

rules.summary: 24-hour Budapest-travelcard permits unlimited travel over 24 hours, except 100E.
when: Passenger holds a valid 24-hour Budapest-travelcard.
rules.expected: Allow eligible regular services for 24 hours from its specified start; do not claim the travelcard itself covers 100E.
exceptions: Special service exclusions and geographic scope still apply.
ask_if_missing: Do you intend to take 100E, or another route to the airport?

rules.summary: Foreign student ID now requires Hungarian address proof for discounted higher-education Budapest student pass.
when: Passenger relies on a qualifying non-Hungarian EU/EEA/Swiss or international ISIC student ID.
Travel date is on or after 2026-06-15.
rules.expected: Explain that eligible EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship, a valid accepted student ID and official proof of an address in Hungary are required; a foreign student ID alone is insufficient.
exceptions: A Hungarian student ID follows different citizenship rules (R016).
Other eligibility rules (e.g., study programme and acceptable documents) still apply.
ask_if_missing: Citizenship? Which country's student ID? Valid address document in Hungary? Higher education full-time/evening?

rules.summary: Hungarian student IDs do not require EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship for this student-pass category.
when: Passenger holds a valid Hungarian student ID appropriate to the higher-education pass.
rules.expected: Do not reject student-pass eligibility solely because the traveller is not an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen; assess remaining conditions.
exceptions: The student ID must be valid and match the pass type.
ask_if_missing: Do you have a currently valid Hungarian student ID for the relevant course?

rules.summary: One dog may be carried free within Budapest if owner holds a valid pass or has free-travel entitlement.
when: Passenger has a valid pass or free-travel entitlement.
Travel is within Budapest.
They bring one dog.
rules.expected: Recognise the documented free carriage of one dog, without recommending a separate dog ticket automatically.
exceptions: Beyond Budapest the fare treatment differs.
Additional vehicle and animal safety rules still apply.
ask_if_missing: Is your route entirely within Budapest? Do you hold a valid pass?

rules.summary: Dogs in suitable closed hand-luggage carriers do not need a separate ticket.
when: Dog is transported in a closed carrier that prevents escape and soiling.
rules.expected: Do not require a separate dog ticket solely for the animal in a compliant closed hand-luggage-sized carrier.
exceptions: Normal animal handling and safety conditions remain relevant.
ask_if_missing: Is the dog fully enclosed in a suitable carrier?

rules.summary: Dogs not in a closed carrier must be leashed and muzzled, and valid vaccination papers carried.
when: Passenger brings a dog outside a compliant closed carrier.
rules.expected: Explain leash plus muzzle are required, and valid vaccination documentation must be available.
exceptions: Special assistance-dog provisions may differ and should be checked before advising.
ask_if_missing: Will the dog be in an enclosed carrier? Is it an assistance dog?

rules.summary: A block of ten paper single tickets cannot be partially refunded under general rules.
when: Passenger seeks an ordinary refund for a block of 10 paper single tickets.
rules.expected: Explain that refund requires all ten unused, consecutively numbered tickets; a partially used block is not refundable under the general rule.
exceptions: A special exchange window for partially used blocks ended in August 2026; do not confuse exchange with refund.
ask_if_missing: Were all ten tickets unused? Are they consecutively numbered? Are you asking for a refund or exchange?

rules.summary: Unused paper singles may be refunded with a fee, subject to the valid price period.
when: Passenger requests a refund of an unused ordinary paper single ticket.
rules.expected: Explain the published 300 HUF handling fee and the valid-price or post-price-change time window; refer to customer service.
exceptions: Ticket identification and other refund conditions must be met.
ask_if_missing: Is it unused? What fare is printed? When was it purchased?

rules.summary: Mobile tickets are not replaceable; unused eligible mobile tickets have app-based refund conditions.
when: Passenger wants to replace or refund a mobile ticket.
rules.expected: Explain that mobile-ticket replacements are not offered; unused eligible single/time tickets may be refunded through the app within one year of purchase.
exceptions: Passes and special categories have distinct start-of-validity/refund rules.
ask_if_missing: What exact digital fare product is it? Has it been used? When was it bought?
